summary.text: Laura Bassett is the Republican candidate for California State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Catherine Blakespear.

According to her campaign website, she is a lifelong Oceanside resident who works as a licensed real estate professional and licensed professional fiduciary and serves as a San Diego County Civil Service Commissioner.

paragraphs.text: Laura Bassett's campaign website says she grew up in Oceanside, where she and her husband, Taylor, raised six children whom they homeschooled.

It says she earned a Bachelor of Science degree in accounting from the University of Southern California in 1989, has been a licensed real estate professional since 2003 and a licensed professional fiduciary since 2011, and founded and operates two businesses in real estate and fiduciary services.
The site also says she is an ambassador for the Oceanside Chamber of Commerce and has volunteered for many years at the Historic Star Theater.
